data.title: User data concatenated into raw SQL (SQL injection)
data.message: The SQL at raw execution site Db::query concatenates a variable directly (at /samples/php-projects/thinkphp/CRMEB/crmeb/app/adminapi/controller/v1/setting/SystemCrud.php:599) — high-risk SQL injection
data.remediation: Switch to parameterised queries (? / :name placeholders, or ->where('col = ?', [$var])), never concatenate user input into an SQL string; if a table / column name must be concatenated, validate it against an allowlist.

data.title: CORS reflected origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin set to the request Origin)
data.message: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is set to the request Origin (at /samples/php-projects/thinkphp/CRMEB/crmeb/app/outapi/route/route.php:107) — reflected origin, credential-level cross-origin leak
data.remediation: Use a fixed allowlist of origins, or do "compare against the allowlist and echo back" per request; never reflect request->header('origin') / $_SERVER['HTTP_ORIGIN'] back verbatim.

data.title: GET endpoint performs a write
data.message: Contract GET /crontab/clear_poster is a GET but contains a write verb, violating REST read-only semantics (a retry or prefetch may trigger the write)
data.remediation: Change the endpoint to a write method such as POST / DELETE; if it really is a read-only clear / delete preview, rename it to avoid the write verb

data.title: GET endpoint performs a write
data.message: Contract GET /system/clear/:* is a GET but contains a write verb, violating REST read-only semantics (a retry or prefetch may trigger the write)
data.remediation: Change the endpoint to a write method such as POST / DELETE; if it really is a read-only clear / delete preview, rename it to avoid the write verb
